name: Jordan Lee
headline: Technology Executive | Cloud Platforms, Site Reliability & Enterprise Architecture
summary: Fictional example. Technology executive with 18 years leading cloud, infrastructure and platform organizations in financial services and retail. Built a 300-person global engineering organization, moved core banking workloads to the public cloud, and raised customer-facing availability to 99.99%.
highlights: Led a 300-person global engineering organization across four countries with a $90M annual budget.
Migrated 2,400 applications to AWS and Azure in 30 months, retiring three data centers.
Raised availability of customer-facing platforms from 99.5% to 99.99% through an SRE program.
Cut annual cloud spend 22% ($14M) with a FinOps practice and reserved-capacity planning.

paragraphs: Fictional example. Example Bank's plan to move its core platforms to the cloud while holding 99.99% availability is the work I have led for the past six years.

At Example Financial Group I led the migration of 2,400 applications to AWS and Azure and retired three data centers, while building an SRE function that raised customer-facing availability from 99.5% to 99.99%.
I also founded a FinOps practice that cut annual cloud spend 22% ($14M) as usage grew 35%, and reported technology risk and resilience to the board risk committee every quarter.
I would welcome a conversation about the next stage of your cloud program.
